title: CUNO: Curriculum and Preference Optimization for Stable Graph Unlearning under Mass Deletion
abstract: arXiv:2609.08244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph unlearning removes the influence of designated training data from a trained graph model without retraining from scratch. However, existing methods suffer a sharp drop in model utility under large deletion ratios (mass deletion), a phenomenon we refer to as catastrophic unlearning. We find that a key cause is the uniform treatment of all deleted samples, which is particularly damaging in graph learning: structural dependencies cause different nodes to play vastly different roles in the learned model, yet existing methods apply the same forgetting operation to the entire forget set. Based on this insight, we propose CUNO, a curriculum-based graph unlearning framework that removes the forget set progressively, ordering samples by their estimated unlearning difficulty across multiple stages. translated_title: CUNO：面向大规模删除下稳定图遗忘的课程学习与偏好优化
translated_abstract: 图遗忘旨在无需从头重新训练的情况下，从已训练的图模型中移除指定训练数据的影响。然而，现有方法在大删除比例（大规模删除）下会出现模型效用急剧下降的现象，我们将其称为“灾难性遗忘”。我们发现一个关键原因是对所有被删除样本采取统一处理方式，这在图学习中尤其有害：结构依赖性导致不同节点在已学习模型中扮演着截然不同的角色，但现有方法却对整个遗忘集应用相同的遗忘操作。基于这一洞察，我们提出了CUNO，一个基于课程学习的图遗忘框架，它将遗忘样本按估计的遗忘难度排序，在多个阶段中渐进式地移除遗忘集。CUNO进一步在每个课程阶段采用分布级的负偏好优化（NPO）目标，引导模型远离……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出CUNO框架，通过按遗忘难度对样本排序并分阶段渐进移除，结合分布级负偏好优化目标，有效缓解了大规模删除下图遗忘中的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: CUNO is a curriculum-based graph unlearning framework that progressively removes forget samples ordered by estimated unlearning difficulty with distribution-level negative preference optimization, preventing catastrophic unlearning under mass deletion.
